name: withcraft
description: Show GitHub Action inputs and outputs where you use them in workflow files.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Remote action metadata resolves normally in virtual workspaces. Local action references (./path) cannot be read without access to the real filesystem and will silently return no metadata.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Withcraft only reads workflow metadata and never executes workspace code. In untrusted workspaces, host and request settings are ignored so a repository cannot redirect token-bearing requests to an arbitrary endpoint.

withcraft.hover.enabled.description: Enable hovers for GitHub Action uses entries and with inputs.

withcraft.hover.uses.enabled.description: Enable hovers on `uses:` entries (action name, version, inputs summary). Disable if another extension already provides this information and you prefer to avoid duplicate hovers.

withcraft.hover.inputs.enabled.description: Show declared inputs in uses hovers.

withcraft.hover.outputs.enabled.description: Show declared outputs in uses hovers.

withcraft.completion.enabled.description: Enable completion for GitHub Action with inputs and step outputs.

withcraft.githubHosts.description: GitHub hosts to query for remote action metadata. Use github.com for public GitHub and host names such as github.example.com for GitHub Enterprise Server.

withcraft.github.requestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for each GitHub API or metadata request.

withcraft.logging.level.description: Controls Withcraft diagnostic output. Info logs compact resolution decisions; debug adds cache and per-host details.

withcraft.cache.maxEntries.description: Maximum number of remote action metadata entries kept in memory.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.vscode-engine: VSCODE_API="$(npm view @types/vscode version)" && npm pkg set "engines.vscode=^${VSCODE_API}" && npm install "@types/vscode@${VSCODE_API}"
